params.1273: Use a weapon's special attack in combat.
params.1274: You will find your combat styles in the sidebar marked with a pair of crossed swords.
params.1275: If your weapon has a special attack, you will see a Special Attack Bar. Click on this to make your next attack use the special.
params.1276: This will drain a percentage of your special attack bar, which will take a while to recover.
params.2225: Special attacks are unique to the weapon and have a variety of effects and costs. Keep an eye out for such weapons.
